program.name: Twist and Fold
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Short yoga for the spine and hamstrings: standing twists, or seated folds.
program.about: A short practice for a stiff back and tight legs. One day twists through standing poses; the other folds forward on the floor with head-to-knee and seated folds. They alternate and close with a rest. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
